review_fix.finding: Second review: conflict literal/null setters could be replaced through application embedding.
review_fix.resolution: Literal capture uses a private closed constraint combining exact framework storage layouts with sealed model/column metadata and typed Set. External defined types cannot inherit the sealed method; embedding wrappers cannot match the layouts. Only framework setters can run. Null capture reads the selected nullable column directly from sealed expression metadata.
review_fix.compatibility: Ordinary ConflictSet(column,input) and ConflictNull(column) calls and old-query SQL/binding parity are preserved. ConflictSet requires the declared column value; application wrappers cannot supply replacement setters. Encrypted columns remain compile-time rejected.
tests: Every ordinary/distinct-input column family accepts typed literal capture; zero declarations fail safely.
Five external embedding compile-fail cases cover wrong input, forged nullability, and same-input/different-input destination redirection.
Two additional encrypted literal/null compile-fail cases preserve the forbidden capability.
External nullable and nullable distinct-input wrappers cannot invoke SetNull overrides or alter SQL/bindings.
